title: Omnipod unable to insert cannula
body:
I'm unable to insert cannula.
AAPS conncet to the pod and activate the priming process , but later in Insert Cannula I immmediatly see the retray button , that does nothing

Tried 4 pods same issue

Tried on 2 differernt phones 
pixel 6a  android 16
Samsung A54 android 16
AAPS version is 3.4.0.0

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f7243d45-92e2-4019-90d1-9e1e13e2f3e3)

[AndroidAPS._2026-02-07_22-24-01_.0.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25159741/AndroidAPS._2026-02-07_22-24-01_.0.zip)

comments.body:
Well the problem was that no profile was set...
I think that should be a warning before trying to activate a pod when there is no active profile. Cost me 4 pods...
Created a PR to try and resolve this, but it's so far untested.
